parameter-group.name: manual
parameter-group.label: Manual Setup
parameter-group.description: Only needed without a Dyson account bridge (e.g. from the sticker on the device).

parameter.name: serialNumber
parameter.label: Serial Number
parameter.description: Serial number of the device, e.g. VS6-EU-HJA1234A.

parameter.name: connectionType
parameter.label: Connection Type
parameter.description: How to connect to the device. Cloud connections require a Dyson account bridge.

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Host Name
parameter.description: Host name or IP address of the device for local connections. Defaults to <serial number>.local (mDNS). A fixed IP address is recommended.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds at which the current state is requested from the device.

parameter.name: removeUnsupportedChannels
parameter.label: Remove Unsupported Channels
parameter.description: Removes the channels of features that the device does not report, shortly after the first connection. Re-create the thing to restore them.

parameter.name: localPassword
parameter.label: Local Password
parameter.description: Password of the MQTT broker on the device (Wi-Fi password from the sticker). Retrieved from the cloud when an account bridge is used.

parameter.name: mqttPrefix
parameter.label: MQTT Prefix
parameter.description: Root MQTT topic of the device (product type), e.g. 438M or 527. Retrieved from the cloud when an account bridge is used.

parameter.name: capabilities
parameter.label: Capabilities
parameter.description: Comma separated device capabilities, e.g. AdvanceOscillationDay1,Scheduling,ExtendedAQ,Heating, Humidifier. Retrieved from the cloud when an account bridge is used.
